events.description: A cluster of three roads at junction loc_0081—road_0124, road_0125, and road_0141—are closed. This low‑degree node lies close to the straight line between start and goal, so blocking all three forces a detour around the eastern flank of the network.
An accident on road_0091 (loc_0059 to loc_0139) blocks a narrow corridor that lies near the axis of travel, potentially causing significant delays for vehicles heading toward the goal.

Road_0178 (loc_0111 to loc_0115) and road_0185 (loc_0115 to loc_0017) experience moderate congestion. Both roads share the junction loc_0115, a key link close to the main path; the slowdown reduces speeds by a factor of 2.5.
